name: Omapager Pro
author: Dragos Robu (fork of Omapager by Neil Jagdish Patel)
description: Notifications for Omarchy, with touchpad gestures: two-finger swipe a card away, or swipe the top card of a group to clear the whole group. A fork of Omapager - stacking, grouping, inline reply, per-source snooze - with decks that scroll instead of running off the screen.

barWidget.description: Appears when notifications are being held back or a detected share is waiting for a snooze decision. Click the sharing indicator to choose a timed snooze; notification delivery is never changed automatically.

schema.label: Notification grouping
schema.description: Use one notification group or a separate group for each source.

schema.label: Action button alignment
schema.description: Align action buttons to the left or right.

schema.label: Show countdown animation
schema.description: Animate the time remaining along the bottom of notifications. Notifications still expire normally when this is off.

schema.label: Swipe in from the right edge
schema.description: Two fingers sliding onto the touchpad over its right edge pull in what you missed - notifications that timed out or were held back - the way Notification Center opens on a Mac. Reading the touchpad needs a one-time rule: sudo ./install-touchpad-access.sh in the plugin folder.

schema.label: Notification font size (%)
schema.description: Scale notification text, action buttons and inline replies relative to the theme. 100 follows the theme; the bar and panel keep their usual sizes.

schema.label: Hide the browser's Settings button
schema.description: Hide the repeated Settings action on browser notifications.

schema.label: Snooze durations
schema.description: Choose the durations available in notification and panel snooze menus.

schema.label: Tomorrow morning starts at
schema.description: The hour "until tomorrow" wakes a source at, on a 24-hour clock.

schema.label: Sources listed in the panel
schema.description: Maximum number of snoozed sources listed in the panel.

schema.label: Held notifications shown per source
schema.description: Maximum number of held notifications shown for each source.

schema.label: Recent notifications in the panel
schema.description: Number of recent notifications shown when Recent is expanded. Clears on shell restart.

schema.label: Always show indicator
schema.description: Keep the bar indicator visible when no notifications are held.

schema.label: Allow verification codes during quiet mode
schema.description: Allow verification-code notifications during snooze and Do Not Disturb.

schema.label: Time format
schema.description: Use the system time format, 24-hour time or 12-hour time.

schema.label: Match browser window titles
schema.description: Match notification websites to browser window titles when focusing a window.

schema.label: Notification display
schema.description: Use the active display, a selected output or all displays.

schema.label: Specific monitor output name
schema.description: Output name for specific-display mode. The selection is retained while disconnected.

schema.label: Suggest snooze during screen sharing
schema.description: Offer a timed snooze when screen sharing starts. Notifications are not muted automatically.

schema.label: Invoke app action on card click
schema.description: On: a click runs what the app asked a click to do (a terminal focusing its tab, a chat app opening the conversation), as Omarchy's own notification service does. Off: a click only focuses a known window or opens the source's site; app actions stay as buttons.

schema.label: History retention
schema.description: 0 disables history; otherwise 1, 24 or 168 hours. Maximum 100 entries.

schema.label: Clear copied codes after
schema.description: Seconds, only when the clipboard still contains the copied code.
